The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. For science, music, sport, etc, Europe uses the same vocabulary. The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable: one could refuse to pay expensive translators. To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation and more common words. If several languages coalesce, the grammar of the resulting language is more simple and regular than that of the individual languages.

The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. It will be as simple as Occidental; in fact, it will be Occidental. NovaHire is an AI-powered recruitment platform designed to streamline the hiring process by automating candidate sourcing, screening, and matching to help companies find top talent faster and more efficiently.
How does NovaHire use AI in recruitment?

NovaHire leverages machine learning algorithms and natural language processing to analyze resumes, job descriptions, and candidate profiles. It then recommends the best-fit candidates, reducing manual work and improving hiring accuracy.
Can NovaHire integrate with existing HR systems?
Yes, NovaHire easily integrates with popular HR software, Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), and communication tools to ensure a seamless hiring workflow without disrupting existing processes.
How does NovaHire ensure fairness and reduce bias?

NovaHire’s algorithms are designed to focus on skills, experience, and qualifications rather than personal identifiers. This helps reduce unconscious bias in hiring and promotes diversity in candidate selection.
Who can benefit from using NovaHire?

NovaHire is ideal for HR teams, recruiters, and business owners in organizations of all sizes. Whether you’re a startup or a large enterprise, NovaHire helps optimize hiring efficiency, cut costs, and improve talent acquisition.
